_doc: Classic control classes (SPEC GP4 FR-GP4.2, built from app/globals.css, components/funnel/funnel.css and components/workflow-canvas/canvas.css on 2026-10-09). Read by scripts/g-audit.mjs (runtime guard) and tests/g-controls.test.ts (source guard). A new Classic class is one line in `classes`. `onControlOnly` classes fail only when the element carrying them is itself a control (glass-* also dress plain panels). `utilityOnControl` utilities fail only on button, a, input, select, textarea. `kitControlClasses` are the kit's own control recipes (FR-GP4.1) that satisfy the guard like a data-g attribute.
